state.question: In which month of 2026 (as a month number) did the Colaba Causeway store make the most revenue?
state.sql:
SELECT strftime('%m', o.order_date) AS month, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN stores s ON o.store_id = s.id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
WHERE s.name = 'Colaba Causeway'
  AND strftime('%Y', o.order_date) = '2026'
GROUP BY strftime('%m', o.order_date)
ORDER BY revenue DESC
